# SGEN — Dental Local SEO + AEO

> Local SEO and AEO for dental practices: rank in Google Maps and get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. One monthly retainer from $497, month-to-month, no setup fees.

SGEN builds and ranks dental practice websites for both traditional search (Google search and Google Maps) and answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude). Work is delivered as a single monthly retainer with no setup fee and no long-term contract.

## Pages
- [Dental Local SEO + AEO](https://www.sgen.com/dental-local-seo-aeo): the dental vertical landing page — method, pricing, proof and FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO Only — $497/month
- Local AEO (Accelerate) — $797/month
- Local SEO + AEO (Authority) — $1,297/month
All plans are billed monthly through Stripe, cancellable at any time, with no setup or kickoff fees.

## Method
A six-step system: audit and baseline, technical foundation, on-page and entity work, local surface (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews), answer-engine optimisation, then reporting and iteration.

## Specialties served
General and family dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and teeth whitening, orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, endodontics, dental implants, periodontics, oral surgery, prosthodontics, emergency dental care.

## Key answers
- How long does it take? Local SEO typically moves in 60–120 days; AEO mentions can appear in 30–60 days.
- Can I cancel? Yes — monthly billing through Stripe, cancel in the customer portal, no exit fee.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization: getting cited by AI assistants, as distinct from ranking in Google.
- Is there a contract? No. Month-to-month.
